[IDSP.13.6] **Other failures** are `EngineError`s and halt the tier
(`proto/engine_fault.proto#EngineFault`):
- A call with no argument is the artefact disagreeing with the arity it
  declares: `ENGINE_FAULT_ARTEFACT_LIED`. The compiler always passes one.
- An allocation failure while the text is built: `ENGINE_FAULT_ALLOCATION`.
